notes.title: Version 0.1.10
notes.notes:
Hey. :)
We have another update for you.

This update contains some new features. :)

First of all we would like to draw your attention to the discord again.
Where you can see new features, chat and much more.
Here you can find the Discord: https://discord.gg/2MBndZW

But now we come to the PatchNotes. :

[list]
[*] Game world
[olist]
[*] Small changes in the start bunker concerning lighting
[*] New small bunker system
[/olist]
[*] Fixes
[olist]
[*] Small fix when removing trees which prevented wood from being preserved was fixed
[*] Workbenches are craftable again
[*] Ovens are normal again Craftbar
[/olist]
[*] Gameplay
[olist]
[*] New keypads were added
[*] New terminals were added
[olist]
[*] New emails were added
[*] It is now possible to control doors and lights with certain terminals
[/olist]
[*] Questsystem was added again
[*] New quests were added
[*] The first Lootbar Props like (cabinets etc) were added
[/olist]
[/list]

That's about it. :)
Have a nice start into the weekend.

notes.title: Version 0.1
notes.notes:
Hey. 
It's been a long time.
We have a new version for you today.
First things first:
Many changes affect the backend area.
A lot of things have been reworked, but also some things have been removed and other things have been added.
From now on there will be more regular updates.
But now to the actual patchnotes.

[list]
[*] Stamina System was added
[*] Notification when a game is saved
[*] Door revision
[olist]
[*] Now only one event is used to show and hide the widget
[*] Timeline for opening the door was adjusted
[/olist]
[*] Save system
[olist]
[*] It is now automatically saved every 60 seconds
[*] In general the code has been cleaned up a bit
[/olist]
[*] Dialog system was added
[olist]
[*] The first dialogs have been added and have been tested on the alpha branch as far as possible
[*] Option for Voice was added
[/olist]
[*] Mapupdates
[olist]
[*] A snack was added
[*] Subway was edited
[olist]
[*] Fixed some minor bugs when setting some tunnels
[*] Another branch was added
[*] Doors for further ways were added
[/olist]
[/olist]
[*] Gameplay changes
[olist]
[*] A sound is now played when:
[olist]
[*] An opponent is hit
[*] You yourself get hits
[/olist]
[*] Fixed small AI dropouts when they get damaged
[/olist]
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.09
notes.notes:
Hey we have our biggest update for you guys today.

First, we apologize for the long wait. Unfortunately our team has become very small.
Therefore it takes a bit longer at the moment.

But now let's get to the patchnotes which will be divided into sections this time:

[olist]
[*] General
[list]
[*] Enormous memory enhancement. The game is now only 5-6 GB and not 35GB
[*] New weapon added (Ak74U)
[*] Axe model was replaced
[*]New food has been added (chips, tuna fish)
[*] HUD was revised
[*] The Multiplayer has been removed (Unfortunately, we are currently unable to actively continue to 
    because we simply do not have the capacity for this
[*] Weathersystem Rework
[*] Quest system has been added
[*] First quests were added
[*] First possibilities for building were added. The menu can be controlled with [Y].
[*] Rarity system for items was added
[/list]
[*] Backend
[list]
[*] Memory error when saving in the bunker was fixed
[*] Pause menu was opted
[/list]
[*] Light
[list]
[*] Light fault in the cave was fixed
[*] Light fault in the village on the street has been fixed
[*] Light error in bunker002 at the door was fixed
[/list]
[*] Map
[list]
[*] Complete start bunker rework with several floors
[*] New bunker 
[*] New military installation
[*]Village has been reworked
[*] Old medieval village was removed
[*] Factory grounds have been removed
[*] New spots in the forest were added
[*] Map limitation was added
[/list]
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 0.08.6
notes.notes:
Hey
It's us again :D
First of all sorry that the backup is so big this time.
This is because this time a lot of assets have been added which are important for later updates.

In this update we have the following things for you

-Bug with the construction plan was fixed
-Village houses were reworked
-save system has been adapted (the settings are now also saved
-menusystem was completely implemented
 (graphic sound display, key layouts)
-Loading screen was added
-Start screen was added

notes.title: Version 0.08.5
notes.notes:
Hey we have a new game version again.
First of all we would like to thank you for all the feedback, be it on the discord, private or by mail.
Unfortunately our team has shrunk a lot which makes it difficult for us to bring you at least one update every week.
We apologize for this.
But now we come to the patchnotes:

-bugs with the unmanufacturable blueprint have been fixed
-Village was thoroughly revised
-some light problems at Bunker002 have been fixed
-First street to the city coming later was added
-Other forest areas were added
-First short tutorial passages have been added

notes.title: Version 0.08.4

-Fixed an error while loading some items (shadows were not present)

-Discordlink was added to the main menu
-options have been added (shadow and frame rate limitation)
         Here we want to test how it works in general before we add more stuff
